name: Alpenschlössl
beschreibung: The Alpenschlössl guesthouse is situated in Neustift im Stubaital, offering authentic Tyrolean hospitality and culinary traditions. Set in a quiet location at the entrance to the village, the property enjoys lovely views of the surrounding alpine peaks. Guests can enjoy comfortable rooms alongside on-site dining featuring typical regional cuisine. Amenities include a dedicated wellness area and sunbathing lawns ideal for unwinding. The guesthouse caters perfectly to summer hikers and winter skiers alike, with the Stubai mountain lifts reachable in just a few minutes. Distinctive touches include its welcoming family management and immediate proximity to the nature park. The interiors are functional and thoughtfully tailored to active holidaymakers.
